Alliance 1.0 | 700*32C Adult Road Bike

Hiland 6061 Aluminum Frame - Features light weight, easy handling and high durability.
Double Caliper Brakes - Ensures the riding safety.

700*32C Tire - Suitable for different terrains.
14-Speed Drivetrain - Provides a diverse and smooth riding experience.

Lightweight Frame

Hiland road bike is designed for people who like to ride or use it for daily commuting.

The aluminium alloy frame is lightweight, stiff, responsive, and easy to work with.

It’s also more durable and potential for higher speeds, it can withstand a harder impact without cracking or failing.

Handlebars are made of strong aluminum and eco-friendly materials.

Safe Riding

The brake system consists of double caliper brakes which are lighter and more aerodynamic than disc brakes.

It can ensure that riders stop immediately in case of emergency. It is also easy to adjust and maintain.

The combination of 14-speed shift and brake lever is designed to help you change speed and stop smoothly.

700*32C Tire

It takes less energy to keep the bike at speed. 700C wheels have less rolling resistance, making them more efficient, so you can ride further using the same amount of energy.

These wheels also have better rollover capability, because have a larger circumference, they can more easily roll over potholes, bumps, branches, roots, and other obstacles on the road or trail.

Plus, the double wall rim also gives it strong tensile strength, allowing it to be more durable.

Professional Drivetrain

It features 14 speed L-TWOO derailleurs and Shimano shifters, gives diverse riding experience and also ensures total control in every situation, like in gravel, city road or other tough terrain.

Therefore, you can glide over most obstacles without losing speed or getting shaken around too much.

Assembly & Guide

90% pre-assembled, free installation tools and pedals included, easy to assemble within 25 minutes.

Click on the video to see an instructional video on assembly.

Solutions will be quickly provided by support team within 24 hours!

Bikes all have been inspected before package. Solve all your worries!

6061 Aluminum Frame

Aluminum frames are torsionally stiffmore aerodynamic more fast. 3 frame sizes to suit any riders.

Professional 14-Speed Drivetrain

Alliance 1.0 features L-TWOO derailleur and Shimano shifter, gives diverse riding experience and also ensures total control in every situation, like in gravel, city road or other tough terrain.

700*32C Tire

700*32C tire have less rolling resistance, making them more efficient. At the same time, it is also strong tensile resistance, and suitable for various terrains.

Accelerate your fitness with the Hiland Alliance 1.0 Road Bike. Featuring a lightweight aluminum frame, 14-speed Shimano drivetrain, and high-performance 700c wheels. Experience speed and precision on every ride.
